name: 16023 · Cabot, PA
findings: ZIP 16023 (Cabot) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (94%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16023 (Cabot) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16023 (Cabot) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
